title: When temperature stops predicting nitrate
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature and salinity for 2011-2020 and CMEMS biogeochemical reanalysis monthly nitrate for the same years off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), determine how well temperature or density predicts nitrate, where and when the relation breaks down, and why. The two products come from different model systems; account for that.
